phrase: a Gourmet Relish and Jam Brand
verdict: Maybe, as a niche gourmet brand. Nomad Food Project from Delhi pitched bacon-based jams, pickles and relishes on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Gourmet condiments sell at high prices to food lovers, but the market for meat-based products is small in India.
angle: Unusual condiments appeal to food enthusiasts and gift buyers. Cafés and gourmet stores are key channels. Food safety for meat products needs extra care.
